boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Emerson rituals and recurring community events, from staged readings to student-produced showcases.

cards.title: Southwick Recital
cards.subtitle: Emerson’s oral-literature performance tradition
cards.notes: Watch for each recital’s theme, then take in staged prose, poetry, and dramatic monologues that extend Emerson’s longstanding oral-performance practice.
cards.short_summary: A recurring literary performance series rooted in Emerson’s communication tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson identifies the Southwick Recital as its longest-running tradition; the series began in 1900 and modern programs center literary oral tradition.
cards.source_title: Emerson is Celebrating 125 Years of Southwick Recitals on Friday
cards.access_notes: Program, venue, and attendance details vary by recital; check Emerson’s events listings.

cards.title: The EVVY Awards
cards.subtitle: Student-run live awards-show production
cards.notes: Follow the annual show as a spectator or contributor, and look for the student work recognized across media, performance, writing, and communications.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson describes the EVVYs as one of its longest-running traditions; the 45th annual event used two student-produced ceremonies in 2026.
cards.source_title: The Best of Emerson: 45 Years of The EVVYs
cards.access_notes: The show’s date, venue, viewing arrangements, and participation process are announced for each cycle.

cards.title: Emerson Move-In Day Welcome
cards.subtitle: Orientation leaders greet arriving new students
cards.notes: Arrive during your assigned move-in window and expect orientation leaders to help welcome the incoming class around the Boston campus.
cards.short_summary: A spirited start-of-year arrival ritual for new Emersonians.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson’s 2025 Move-In Day coverage calls the day a joyous tradition and documents orientation leaders greeting new students with cheers and bullhorns.
cards.source_title: Emerson Welcomes a New Pride of Lions on Move-In Day
cards.access_notes: Move-in is for assigned residential arrivals; consult Housing and Orientation communications for your time and instructions.

cards.title: New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: Week of Welcome gathering for incoming students
cards.notes: Join the incoming class for the formal welcome, listen for campus voices and performers, and use the gathering to mark the start of Emerson life.
cards.short_summary: The shared welcome ceremony that opens the new student experience.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson’s Road to Emerson schedule lists New Student Convocation as part of Move-In and Orientation Week.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for incoming students during Orientation Week; verify the current year’s time and location through Orientation.

cards.title: Student Org Fair
cards.subtitle: Fall-semester introduction to Emerson organizations
cards.notes: Walk the fair early in the fall, ask current members about meeting formats, and note organizations you want to contact after the event.
cards.short_summary: A decades-old start-of-term tradition for discovering student groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson says students have attended its Student Org Fair for decades at the start of the fall semester to learn about 100-plus organizations.
cards.access_notes: Held at the start of the fall semester; check Emerson’s student-engagement channels for the current location and time.

cards.title: Family and Friends Weekend
cards.subtitle: October campus gathering with families and supporters
cards.notes: Coordinate with visiting family or friends, then choose from the announced classes, performances, and campus activities on the weekend schedule.
cards.short_summary: Emerson’s recurring October weekend for students and their supporters.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson states that it holds Family and Friends Weekend each October, with faculty classes, theatrical performances, and campus activities.
cards.access_notes: Registration and event details are published each year; some activities may have separate requirements.

cards.title: Teach-In On Timely Topics
cards.subtitle: Campus forum on expression, inclusion, and society
cards.notes: Choose a session that fits your interests, arrive ready to listen and participate thoughtfully, and use the program to engage an urgent public question.
cards.short_summary: An Emerson forum connecting timely issues with communication and the arts.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson describes the Teach-In On Timely Topics as a forum for the community to engage urgent questions about expression, inclusion, and society.
cards.access_notes: Themes, dates, and session formats change by year; consult Emerson’s event calendar for current details.

cards.title: Teach-In on Sustainability
cards.subtitle: Workshops and discussions organized around the UN Sustainable Development Goals
cards.notes: Pick a workshop or discussion, learn how Emersonians connect creative work with sustainability, and bring questions for the presenters.
cards.short_summary: A recurring sustainability-focused series of Emerson community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson describes the Teach-In on Sustainability as a series of events, workshops, and discussions structured around the UN’s 17 Sustainable Development Goals.
cards.access_notes: Programming varies by year; check the current Emerson events calendar before planning to attend.

cards.title: Emerson Film Festival
cards.subtitle: Annual screening and awards program for student and alumni work
cards.notes: Watch the festival schedule for selected screenings, then stay for the program recognizing work by Emerson filmmakers and alumni.
cards.short_summary: An annual campus film showcase that screens Emerson-made work.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson reported that its 23rd annual Emerson Film Festival screened work by student and alumni filmmakers and awarded prizes to student filmmakers.
cards.source_title: Emerson Film Festival Showcases Student, Alum Talent Behind the Camera
cards.access_notes: Screening selections, venue, tickets, and attendance arrangements are announced with each festival.

cards.title: E3 Expo & Pitch Competition
cards.subtitle: Spring capstone for Emerson’s Entrepreneurial Studies program
cards.notes: Attend the spring showcase to hear student venture pitches, see the projects developed through E3 coursework, and follow the competition results.
cards.short_summary: The annual entrepreneurship capstone where Emerson students pitch ventures.
cards.evidence_claim: Emerson says E3 Expo is held every spring as an annual pitch competition and capstone for its Entrepreneurial Studies program.
cards.access_notes: Participation is tied to the E3 program; audience and event details should be confirmed for the current spring program.
